title: Quem pastores laudavere/Den die Hirten - Heut seind die lieben Engelein - Den die Hirten a 4
subtitle: SATB · CPDL #56543

source.description: Automatisch umgewandelt aus der MusicXML-Datei „Quem-pastores89-praetorius.mxl“ der CPDL-Seite „Quem pastores laudavere - Heut seind die lieben Engelein - Den die Hirten a 4 (Michael Praetorius)“ mit tools/liedquellen/cpdl_import.py. Nicht gegen die Vorlage geprüft. Hinweis der Ausgabe: The music of the edition from 1607 is transferred to modern notation with halved note values. Melisms and slurs from the source are shown alwasy as slurs, also some slurs have been added, according to the text distribution with today's notation. "Heut seind die lieben Engelein" begins with two breaks, then the first six bars are repeated. In "Musae Sionia V, No. 88" five bars are repeated for the same text and similar music, so I removed the two half-breaks and noted this bar as a anacrusis. To make the text easier to read, the repetition is written out and the music is doubled for two verses each.
